task: ae.chord: Chord DHT simulation (finger tables, join/stabilize/crash/leave, replicated versioned storage) verified against a TreeSet oracle, the paper example, churn simulation and a mutation check
reasoning_summary: Designed Ring arithmetic, ChordNode (routing, stabilisation, maintenance) and ChordNetwork (simulated RPC, membership, rounds) with an independent TreeSet RingOracle and an Invariants checker run after every churn step. Tests were written first; all 33 passed on the first run, so a 20-mutant mutation script was added: it first showed 2 survivors (lazy pruning masked a leave-splice check; consistent replicas masked newest-version reads), which were closed with sharper tests, then killed 20/20.
